title: Engineering Summit
summaryLead: Summit is a high-performance, precision-engineered web application designed to transform complex Shopify project discovery into actionable technical implementation plans, risk assessments, and launch strategies.
summaryMore: To reflect the platform's focus on efficiency and technical clarity, the marketing landing site was engineered from the ground up without heavy JavaScript frameworks or bloated UI libraries. The result is an ultra-fast, visually striking digital experience deployed globally on the edge, featuring custom design tokens, procedural SVG assets, and fluid CSS architecture.

stack.name: Hosting
stack.detail: Netlify Edge: global CDN, static and SSR delivery, and dynamic Open Graph image generation.

stack.name: Scope
stack.detail: The Summit app itself is built with Next.js 14 and Supabase. This case study covers its framework-free marketing landing site.

stack.name: Markup
stack.detail: HTML5 with full landmark structure and native responsive elements.

stack.name: Styling
stack.detail: Hand-written CSS3 with design tokens as custom properties (--ink, --pine, --lime), CSS Grid, Flexbox and clamp() sizing.

stack.name: Typography
stack.detail: Newsreader, Manrope and DM Mono, loaded asynchronously through the Google Fonts API.

stack.name: Grain texture
stack.detail: A procedural SVG fractal-noise filter (feTurbulence) embedded as a data URI on a fixed body::before layer with mix-blend-mode: multiply. It adds no image request.

stack.name: Score ring
stack.detail: The circular assessment indicator is CSS only: a conic-gradient with a centred pseudo-element. No charting library.

stack.name: Fluid type
stack.detail: clamp() with viewport units scales headlines from phone to desktop without breakpoint overrides or layout shift.

chapters.title: Zero-asset texture and grain system
chapters.challenge: Achieving an organic, tactile paper and grain texture across all display resolutions without increasing payload size or adding blocking network requests.
chapters.solution: We embedded a procedural SVG fractal noise filter (feTurbulence) via a data-URI within a fixed body::before pseudo-element using mix-blend-mode: multiply.
chapters.outcome: Zero additional network latency, instant rendering, and high-DPI scaling across all device types.

chapters.title: Lightweight component rendering: the assessment card
chapters.challenge: Designing an impactful, data-rich preview card that displays real-time scoring metrics without pulling in heavy charting libraries like Chart.js or D3.
chapters.solution: The circular score indicator was built entirely with CSS using conic-gradient combined with a centered pseudo-element to create a donut chart effect.
chapters.outcome: Clean, crisp UI execution rendered in under a millisecond with zero runtime dependencies.

chapters.title: Fluid typographic scaling across devices
chapters.challenge: Creating high-impact headline presentation while eliminating Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) and avoiding complex breakpoint overrides.
chapters.solution: We leveraged CSS clamp() using viewport units to dynamically calculate font sizes across screens.
chapters.outcome: Headlines scale smoothly from phone to wide desktop with no breakpoint overrides.

results.title: Performance
results.text: Sub-millisecond TTFB with top-tier Lighthouse scores across Performance, Accessibility, and Best Practices.

results.title: Maintainability
results.text: Fully decoupled design system controlled entirely through central CSS variables (:root).

results.title: Resilience
results.text: Built on zero third-party framework dependencies, ensuring high long-term stability and minimal maintenance overhead.
